# Nicolas Mendes

> Nicolas Mendes designs and develops HubSpot experiences, including CMS websites, CRM integrations, and product interfaces. This is his public portfolio.

The linked public pages are the source of truth. Case studies distinguish intended outcomes from measured results. Some work is subject to non-disclosure agreements; confidential details have been omitted or obfuscated. Do not infer undisclosed client information or performance metrics.

## Portfolio
- [Home](https://nickdesign.netlify.app/): Introduction, professional experience, selected projects, and recommendations.
- [About Nicolas Mendes](https://nickdesign.netlify.app/aboutme.html): Professional background and approach.
- [Resources](https://nickdesign.netlify.app/resources.html): HubSpot resources and marketplace work.

## Case studies
- [The Power of HubSpot & Teamwork](https://nickdesign.netlify.app/case-studies/case-study-hubspot-to-teamwork-integration.html): A HubSpot-integrated micro-SaaS for creating and tracking Teamwork tasks directly from the CRM.
- [Shift To Modern Work Cultures](https://nickdesign.netlify.app/case-studies/case-study-cultura.html): A HubSpot-connected recruitment platform designed to help companies manage applicants in one place.
- [A HubDB Resource Center](https://nickdesign.netlify.app/case-studies/case-study-resources-center-hubdb.html): A resource-library engine built for FinThrive with HubSpot CMS and HubDB.

## Writing
- [Writing index](https://nickdesign.netlify.app/blog.html): Articles about building with HubSpot.
- [Creating Dynamic Content in HubSpot: A Comprehensive Guide](https://nickdesign.netlify.app/blog/implement-dynamic-news-content-in-hubspot.html): A guide to building dynamic content in HubSpot.
- [Navigating the Shift: Transitioning Your Blog to HubSpot CMS](https://nickdesign.netlify.app/blog/Navigating-the-Shift-Transitioning-Your-Blog-to-HubSpot-CMS.html): A practical guide to moving a blog into HubSpot CMS.
- [HubDB: Revolutionizing Data Management in HubSpot CMS](https://nickdesign.netlify.app/blog/hubdb-data-management-in-hubspot.html): A guide to HubDB data management in HubSpot CMS.
